text: If P is a projective module, then Extⁿ_R(P, N) = 0 for all n ≥ 1 and every module N.
explanation: 0 → P → P → 0 (identity augmentation) is already a projective resolution of length 0, so the derived complex has nothing in higher degrees. Conversely, Ext¹(M, −) = 0 forces every surjection onto M to split, making M projective.
